title: Yet another subscription scheme
body:
I've had it with these app subscription schemes. Despite no continuous online service/backend or other integration is offered or necessary, continuous payment is the only way to access the full feature set.

I can almost hear the zombie-like gasping and yearning for recurring income  from the accounting department.

I'll be taking my money elsewhere...

author: Mvdjdvd

title: An amazing tool!
body: The first week I reduced my screen time by 32%, and I went from opening Instagram every change I got to two or three times a day. I honestly did not thing this app would be helpful. But, it has really helped me be more concious of my scolling and how much time I spend. I have started using time consuming apps more conciously, where I will sit down to check whats new instead of opening my phone every chance. After a weeks time the dopamine rush of checking if there is something new has been reduced, and I am looking foreward to the change in a year. Absolutely worth spending money on!
author: MaritLarsen

title: Download it!
body: Everyone who uses their phone as a distraction in any way should have this! Frankly, it should come with the phone and be activated when screen time goes over 3 hours per day. It is a great tool to take back control over your day, and to reflect on what you truly want, and to connect with your thoughts and feelings instead of sending them away. If you are on a journey of self improvement of any kind, and are reading this, then you need to download. And to those who want them, the pro features are worth it. Xoxo
